content.text: acute termination w verapamil, diltiazem or a BB if the QRS = narrow and regular; for prev when ablation isn’t an option: oral verapamil or diltiazem = recommended; oral digoxin or amiodarone may be reasonable.

digoxin, clonidine, diltiazem and verapamil add brady (slowed AV conduction); stopping clonidine: w.draw the BB several days first (rebound HTN). Strong CYP2D6 inhibitors (fluoxetine, paroxetine, quinidine) can double metoprolol levels. Higher Epi doses may be needed.

severe brady, hypotension, AV block, bronchospasm and cardiogenic shock. Tx brady w atropine, adrenergic drugs or pacing; hypotension w IV vasopressors; shock w glucagon (bolus, then infusion if needed). Hemodialysis = unlikely to help w metoprolol.
